text:
nina: Quick sync — planning a quiet cutover to enable helios-7b-q4 in the catalog during the 03:00-06:00 UTC change window on 2026-04-10. Canary plan: 0.5% (20m) -> 5% (40m) -> 25% (40m) -> 100%. Need agreement on fallback chain, tier pins, and rollback playbook.
deploybot: @nina scheduled route 'catalog:helios-7b-q4-canary' for 2026-04-10T03:00:00Z. Auto-promote unless a :hold: reaction within 15m. I will attach metric hooks: p95_latency, err_rate, token_mismatch.
sam: Suggest default fallback order: helios-7b-fp16 -> helios-7b-q4 (older quant) -> model-regional-default. Keep fp16 as top fallback for any SLA-bound routes.
lia: Rollback triggers proposal: p95 up > 25% vs baseline for 10m OR err_rate > 0.4% sustained 5m. Add tokenization mismatch > 0.15% immediate. Also add content-regression signal: eval set BLEU drop > 2 pts for canary queries -> escalate.
sre-ops: +1 to signals. Also propose a soft-fallback latch: if a route falls back more than 3 times within 15m, deploybot should pause promotions and tag the rollout as 'repeated-fallback'.
docs: We'll update release notes: short bullet explaining quant tradeoffs and fallback precedence. Need exact param name: is it model_variant_preference?
ops-bot: Commit created: rollouts/1767778888-helios-enable.yaml with canary percentages and alerts.
sam: For customer pins: add a tier mapping — reserved_capacity -> helios-7b-fp16, enterprise -> helios-7b-fp16, standard -> helios-7b-q4. Document in the rollout yaml.
nina: Decision draft: fallback chain default: [helios-7b-fp16, helios-7b-q4-compat, regional-default]. Tier pins as sam suggested. Rollback thresholds: lia's numbers. Deploybot to perform automated rollback to top fallback and annotate route audit.
deploybot: Will create tier pin entries and canary. Attaching webhooks: on_threshold_exceeded -> /hooks/rollbacks/catalog/helios-7b-q4 and /notify#runbook. Tags: rollout=helios-7b-q4, window=2026-04-10-03-06Z.
lia: I'll monitor from 02:45-06:15 UTC. Manual rollback command verified: `/deploybot rollback catalog helios-7b-q4 --reason "manual-observation"`.
oncall: oncall ACK. I'll be in #runbook during the window and will coordinate customer notifications if we roll back.
docs: Pushed draft blurb to docs PR #2489 and noted the model_variant_preference param in the SDK section.
sre-ops: Reminder: set fallback TTL alert — don't allow permanent fallback without an owner review after 10 minutes.
nina: Thanks team. If nobody objects within 2 hours I'll hit confirm and let deploybot proceed with the scheduled canary. Keep mobile alerts on. :eyes:
deploybot: Canary scheduled and hooks active. Posting condensed summary to #runbook.
